author: Akien
prose:
[2026-09-15 22:08, on the finding shape and the bands] now i don't know if this was ever completed or not, but a finding (result of an inspection) was supposed to be basically in the form:
sieve name/checks for, expected value (or range or whatever), actual value, pass/fail, 
next sieve in the same format. and there are supposed to be 3 bands, pre, record, and post (or similar names) and this new sieve would be in post i think.

[2026-09-15, on CC's measurement that every live sieve is record and the cheapest pick sorts outside the nest] lets talk about the bands then, we built them for the inference proxy. to pick the least expensive of the paths provided. so capabilities checked first then the post process picked the cheapest. a different kind of compare operation performed on all the available inputs. if it's not like that now, that's a bug.

[2026-09-15, on CC's proposal: band-outer shake, fire(name, subject, stamps), cheapest/prefers become postprocess sieves, teeth sieve moves to post, byte-identity proofs] agreed on all counts.
